visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up, high-detail shot of a gray and white cat sleeping peacefully. The camera focuses on its ears, soft fur, and pink paws as it rests under bright, natural daylight. (2) The scene cuts to a well-lit indoor office environment with wooden flooring and minimalist furniture. A cat appears in a medium shot, wearing a black chest harness that holds a small white action camera. It walks steadily toward the camera. (3) The perspective shifts to a first-person POV from the cat's chest-mounted camera. The cat explores the office at floor level, moving past a yellow floor fan, looking under shelving units, and pausing to look out a large window through horizontal blinds. (4) The cat approaches a light-wood drawer unit and uses its paws and mouth to scratch and pull at the handle gap. The camera shakes with the cat's physical exertion. (5) After several attempts, the drawer opens. The POV camera shows the cat grabbing a clear plastic bag containing pink and white spherical objects. (6) In an external shot, the cat is sitting on the floor with the harness on, holding the bag in its mouth. The video ends with a POV shot of the cat eating the contents on the wooden floor.
